messages:
elaine_cho: Partner asked if we can provide an Azure + Equinix packaging path in the partner accelerator. They want Terraform modules, marketplace metadata for Azure, and a bare-metal note for Equinix. Any quick feasibility callouts?

mike_ramos: Azure Marketplace needs a VM offer manifest or container offer via ACR. We should include an ARM template example and a terraform/azure module. Also include listing.icon/screenshot guidelines.

sam_keller: Equinix: recommend providing an install playbook + AMI-equivalent images (or container runtime) and a terraform/equinix module that provisions metal instances, networking, and optional VLANs. Note: no marketplace upload step for Equinix, but include a partner-ready tarball.

olga_petrov: I'll draft terraform module inputs: arch, region, instance_profile, model_version, autoscale_policy. Add an examples/azure.tfvars and examples/equinix.tfvars.

devrel_bot: repo created: partner-marketplace-variants (private). Invitations sent. ISSUE_TEMPLATE and README scaffolded.

elaine_cho: Good. Add a short section in README: "When to use Azure vs Equinix" and include a compliance/security checklist for on-prem/private metal.

mike_ramos: Timeline: basic modules + README by next Wed, marketplace manifest example + screenshots by Thu, Equinix playbook by Fri. Who owns the Azure manifest example?

olga_petrov: I'll own Azure manifest + terraform module. Sam will help with Equinix networking.

sam_keller: I'll add a small CI matrix: linux/ubuntu amd64 + arm64 build, and a smoke job that can target either Azure or Equinix via variable. Smoke should just deploy a minimal VM, curl /health, and destroy.

elaine_cho: Perfect. I'll prepare partner handoff notes and a one-page checklist.

devrel_bot: Task created PART-509 - azure-equinix-variant-packaging. Due 2026-04-12. Assignees: olga_petrov, sam_keller, mike_ramos, elaine_cho.
